_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05 (batch S3). This is the BASE B.O.B. Alterrain single jogger (NOT the Alterrain Pro). It is the same product family the owner already owns (Alterrain Pro). Clek lists Alterrain / Alterrain Pro as Liing-compatible via BOB Single Infant Car Seat Adapter S12046000 — this fragment confirms the Clek Liing fits the BOB Alterrain family. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: B.O.B. Gear Alterrain Jogging Stroller (base, non-Pro)

clekListed.clekRow: B.O.B. Gear Alterrain / Alterrain Pro — Single Infant Car Seat Adapter (S12046000)

_priceNote: Base Alterrain has been superseded/discontinued new at BOB's DTC (bobgear.com now lists only Wayfinder, Alterrain Pro, Revolution Flex 3.0). Launch MSRP $549.99 (2020). Listings above are the canonical base-model SKUs; both sold out / clearance at check. The owned Alterrain Pro is the current in-market successor.

brake.type: foot-operated, flip-flop-friendly parking brake (center rear pedal). No hand brake — the hand-operated brake is an Alterrain Pro-only feature.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: 8 weeks / 30 lb minimum in the seat; birth-ready with an infant car seat + adapter (S12046000); jogging recommended from ~6–8 mo

safety.standards: Meets US ASTM F833 / 16 CFR 1227 carriage & stroller standard
safety.certifications: 5-point no-rethread easy-adjust harness; auto-lock fold latch; wrist tether. JPMA certification not published by BOB.
safety.notes: Basket weight limit not published by BOB (null).

specs.foldType: one-hand quick fold, self-standing (with wheels on)
specs.tires: air-filled pneumatic; 12 in front swivel wheel (lockable), 16 in rear; SmoothShox spring-loaded suspension; 9-position adjustable handlebar

notes: This is the OWNED product family (owner has the Alterrain Pro). Confirms the Clek Liing fits the BOB Alterrain family via BOB's Single Infant Car Seat Adapter S12046000 (adapter-s12046000) — the correction the study forces on clek-liing.fitsAlterrain. Base Alterrain is a 31.3 lb full-size trail/jogging stroller — the heavy/rugged complement to a light city stroller, not itself the city/shopping answer. Base model is discontinued new; the in-market successor is the Alterrain Pro (adds hand brake + all-weather canopy).
